name: MBA in Finance
aliases: Master of Business Administration in Finance
summary: An MBA in Finance combines general management study with financial decision-making. Programmes cover accounting, corporate finance, investment analysis, financial markets, risk management and business strategy, often with a summer internship and a final project. Entry usually requires a bachelor's degree, while subject prerequisites, entrance tests and work-experience requirements vary. Graduates may pursue finance and management roles or further study; professional licensing and employment requirements depend on the jurisdiction and employer.
metaTitle: MBA Finance Programmes: Entry, Fees and Study Options
metaDescription: Compare MBA Finance programmes by entry requirements, curriculum, practical training, tuition, duration and admission route for your qualifications.

name: Integrated M.Tech in Biotechnology
aliases: Integrated Master of Technology in Biotechnology
summary: An integrated M.Tech in Biotechnology combines undergraduate engineering foundations with advanced biotechnology study in a continuous school-entry route. Coursework can include mathematics, chemistry, molecular biology, bioprocess engineering, genetic engineering and laboratory methods, followed by advanced projects or research. Applicants enter after upper-secondary education with the required science subjects. Duration, intermediate awards and progression rules vary by institution; compare the full integrated structure before applying.
metaTitle: Integrated M.Tech Biotechnology: Entry and Study Options
metaDescription: Compare Integrated M.Tech Biotechnology programmes by school-entry subjects, degree structure, teaching language, duration, practical study and tuition.

name: Integrated M.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering
aliases: Integrated Master of Technology in Computer Science and Engineering
summary: An integrated M.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering combines undergraduate computing and engineering foundations with advanced postgraduate study in one school-entry route. Programmes can cover programming, algorithms, computer systems, networks, software engineering and specialised computing topics, with project or research work. Entry follows upper-secondary education with the required mathematics and science subjects. Duration, intermediate awards and progression requirements vary, so the full integrated route should be compared with separate bachelor and master degrees.
metaTitle: Integrated M.Tech CSE: Entry and Study Options
metaDescription: Compare Integrated M.Tech CSE programmes by school-entry subjects, degree structure, teaching language, duration, practical study and tuition.

name: Integrated M.Tech in Geoinformatics
aliases: Integrated Master of Technology in Geoinformatics
Integrated M.Tech Geological Technology and Geoinformatics
summary: An integrated M.Tech in Geoinformatics combines undergraduate scientific and engineering foundations with advanced study of spatial data, geographic information systems and remote sensing. Programmes may emphasise geological technology, mapping, satellite-image interpretation, environmental applications and research projects. Entry is after upper-secondary education with prescribed mathematics and science subjects. Duration, intermediate awards and progression rules depend on the institution; this school-entry route is distinct from a postgraduate M.Tech requiring a prior degree.
metaTitle: Integrated M.Tech Geoinformatics: Entry and Study Options
metaDescription: Compare Integrated M.Tech Geoinformatics programmes by school-entry subjects, degree structure, teaching language, duration, practical study and tuition.
